chapter: Melvin Moore, Hammond and the New York trip
title: Melvin Moore first appears with Don Albert's band
summary: In Tulsa with Don Albert, young Melvin Moore says he will join Fields' band once he finishes high school in Oklahoma City.

story.theme_name: Playing with Count Basie: joining, leading, leaving
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: And so, anyway, then we got to kind of move on, there I was, it looked like I always had those good vocalists, and at that time that was what was setting the band then. Now, T. Holder had Billy Maxted and I would talk to T and I don't know anybody this and

that, and so finally Don Albert came to Tulsa and Melvin Moore was with him, and I had been going wild over Roy and Pee Wee, but now this is it. And so, he told me, I don't know he said, I told my dad I was going to finish high school anyway and I think he said next year I'm going back to school, I just got one year.

So then we got talking and he said Oklahoma City is right close, I could still make a few gigs with you, but soon as I finish, he says, I'll join the group but I'm going to finish high school. He said I promised dad that. So I said, well, I can't hardly talk against that and I'd say well, I guess you're thinking right, because I didn't have at that time--later on I had a band as good as Don Albert; Don Albert had one hell of a band, and so sure enough, never left Don and went on back then and I just picked up somebody and we made
out whatever we can and if I had a real good gig I would get Melvin to come over from Oklahoma City, if we were playing in Tulsa.
